text:
This looks like a square dinner plate of about 26 cm. It holds three pizza slices (thin, cheese), an arugula salad with olives, and roasted broccoli with cherry tomatoes.

Pizza: three small rectangular pieces, each about 6x8 cm. Together that is roughly 150 g, at about 270 kcal per 100 g, so about 400 kcal.

Salad: about 50 g of arugula, plus a few olives and some dressing. That is about 60 kcal.

Broccoli and tomatoes: about 100 g, with oil, so about 80 kcal.

Total mass is about 300 g and total energy is about 540 kcal.
